## public pages

- [shashank sn - idiot savant](https://shashanksn.xyz/): personal homepage for shashank sn, focused on brand systems, founder-led positioning, and the operating record behind the work.
- [shashank sn - fractional cbo](https://shashanksn.xyz/cbo/): fractional chief brand officer offer for post-pmf startups, scaling d2c brands, and b2b companies with positioning problems that cost revenue.
- [shashank's ghostwriter - a claude skill](https://shashanksn.xyz/ghost): a claude skill built around shashank's writing structure, argument logic, and idea development patterns.
- [brand arsenal - brand strategy micro-courses for founders](https://shashanksn.xyz/brand-arsenal/): a compact brand strategy system for founders who need clearer positioning, trust signals, category logic, offers, and founder voice.
- [websites & apps - shashank sn](https://shashanksn.xyz/websites-and-apps/): selected websites and apps designed or built by shashank sn, including hold your voice, just nai, and say about us.
- [brand engine - complete brand strategy in 21 days](https://shashanksn.xyz/brand-engine/): a structured 21-day brand strategy program for founders who want positioning, messaging, and brand architecture.
- [newsletter engine - email list to revenue in 30 days](https://shashanksn.xyz/newsletter-engine/): a 30-day email course for founders and marketers who want to turn a newsletter into a business asset.
- [signal engine - high-leverage writing framework](https://shashanksn.xyz/signal-engine/): a high-leverage writing framework for creators and founders who want sharper, more specific public ideas.
- [hold your voice - open-source writing tool](https://shashanksn.xyz/holdyourvoice/): a local-first, mit-licensed writing tool that helps writers keep their voice when they work with ai.
- [thoughts - shashank sn](https://shashanksn.xyz/thoughts/): notes on brand, business, and the work behind the work by shashank sn.
- [inside GUVI’s two guinness world records strategy](https://shashanksn.xyz/thoughts/inside-guvis-two-guinness-world-records-strategy/): a first-hand case study of how GUVI used vernacular education, proof, and two guinness world records to make its brand position hard to argue with.
- [what my parents knew about trust](https://shashanksn.xyz/thoughts/what-my-parents-knew-about-trust/): thirty-five years inside a family printing press taught shashank what recommendation really costs.
- [the scar that started dodo payments](https://shashanksn.xyz/thoughts/the-scar-that-started-dodo-payments/): a case study of a payments company built from the revenue its founder could not collect.
- [the scroll test](https://shashanksn.xyz/thoughts/the-scroll-test/): interview notes on making a company publication worth reading on its own.
- [the product is the possibility](https://shashanksn.xyz/thoughts/the-product-is-the-possibility/): an essay about the value that lives above the artifact a consultant hands over.
- [they went with the cheaper one](https://shashanksn.xyz/thoughts/they-went-with-the-cheaper-one/): what selling specialty coffee taught shashank about being easier to choose.
- [the more you explain, the worse it gets](https://shashanksn.xyz/thoughts/the-more-you-explain-the-worse-it-gets/): a short note about why adding words rarely fixes unsettled positioning.
- [the five-second test most founders fail](https://shashanksn.xyz/thoughts/the-five-second-test-most-founders-fail/): a human-first test for finding repeated confusion on a homepage.
